title: ESTIMETR Trial Starts at Explicit Activation
description: แยกด่านสมาชิกเว็บออกจากด่านสิทธิ์ทดลองใช้แอป ตามโมเดลสองด่าน: authentication สร้าง Platform Membership อย่างเดียว นาฬิกา ESTIMETR 5 วันเริ่มนับเมื่อสมาชิกกดเริ่มทดลองใช้อย่างชัดแจ้งหลังเห็นเงื่อนไข การอ่านสิทธิ์ไม่เขียนฐานข้อมูล และ ADR 0006 supersede จุดเริ่มนาฬิกาใน ADR 0003
scope: record ADR 0006 superseding only the trial start point in ADR 0003
split trial issuance into ensurePersonalOrganization on the write path and activateEstimeterTrial from a server action
keep getEstimeterAccess as a read path that reports not_activated when no entitlement row exists
start the five-day window from the activation instant, not from users.created_at
show trial terms next to an explicit start control and write entitlement.trial_activated with acceptedTerms
refuse project creation and take-off mutation until the trial is activated, on both the page and the write path
verification: pnpm typecheck, pnpm lint (0 warnings), pnpm test (100 passed with the opt-in database suites enabled), pnpm build and pnpm security:check pass
unit tests cover the activation window, not_activated capabilities and the project-creation denial that tells the member to start the trial first

opt-in PostgreSQL tests cover GET writing nothing, the clock starting at activation, a second click refusing to extend the window, one row under concurrent activation, and read-only access after expiry
GitHub tag v0.16.0-estimeter-trial-activation pushed; PR #6 Quality Gate and Vercel pass after ea0974e CI workflow fix
rollback: Revert the v0.16.0 commit or return to tag v0.15.0-estimeter-manual-takeoff. No migration runs in this release. Dev entitlement rows written under the old clock stay valid until deleted; after revert they would be read as trials again.
constraints: No schema change or migration in this release; not_activated is inferred from a missing entitlement row.
The five-day, one-project, export/print lock and read-only retention terms remain those of ADR 0003.
The trial is bound to one organization once; a new email still receives a new trial, the same limitation as before.
Local database is development-only; leftover entitlement rows from v0.13.0 keep the old clock until deleted.
